page_title: Fungal Stain Culture And Identification Body Fluid Test Price, Range & Preparation

faqs.question: What does the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal infections in your body fluids.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal infections in body fluids, such as cerebrospinal fluid, pleural fluid, or ascitic fluid • To determine the appropriate antifungal treatment based on the identified fungus • To monitor the effectiveness of antifungal treatment • To assess the risk of developing complications associated with fungal infections

faqs.question: When is the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid recommended, and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended in the following situations: • Suspected fungal infections in body fluids, indicated by symptoms like fever, inflammation, or localised pain • Patients at a higher risk of fungal infections, such as individuals with weakened immune systems or those undergoing long-term antibiotic therapy • Patients already diagnosed with a fungal infection to monitor treatment progress

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate a fungal infection in body fluids.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid?
faqs.answer: During this test, a sample of body fluid, such as cerebrospinal fluid, pleural fluid, or ascitic fluid, will be collected in a sterile, leak-proof container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for analysis through automated MALDITOF technology (Vitek MS).

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid?
faqs.answer: • Follow any additional instructions provided by your doctor regarding fasting or medication. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid?
faqs.answer: Along with this test, your doctor may recommend blood tests to assess the patient's immune function and detect any underlying conditions contributing to fungal infections.

faqs.question: What is the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Body Fluid also known as?
faqs.answer: Fungal Culture Test or Fungal Identification Test for Body Fluids

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is a condition caused by the invasion of fungi, such as yeasts or molds, into the body. Fungal infections can affect various body parts and can be localised or systemic. Common types include candidiasis, aspergillosis, and cryptococcosis.
